title: Followed by a 12-year-old tall white girl on the walk back to the Nellis barracks

tellings.quote: following me was the tall white girl that the 12-year-old

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years at a US Air Force base in Nevada living near tall, pale-skinned beings he calls the Tall Whites, says that in 1965 one of them, a girl who seemed about 12, followed him as he walked back to his barracks at Nellis Air Force Base. Hall tells Michels he saw this himself: "following me was the tall white girl that the 12-year-old." He names other figures from his story too, a being he calls the Teacher and a man he calls Range Four Harry, and if it happened, it would mean non-human beings lived in close contact with US airmen.
